title: Towards Attribute-Entangled Controllable Text Generation: A Pilot Study of Blessing Generation
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset and evaluates models for the task of blessing generation. While the dataset contains religious occasions (e.g., Christmas, Easter) and religious language (e.g., 'Lord Jesus', 'prayers'), the study's focus is on the technical aspects of attribute entanglement in controllable text generation, rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
